exposure: planned mode of delivery (ECS vs. IOL)
cohort: Twin pregnancies referred to the Department of Obstetrics at Kolding University Hospital, Denmark, between January 2007 and April 2019
finding: Induction of labor in twin pregnancies was not associated with worse maternal or neonatal outcomes compared to elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was not associated with worse outcomes compared to elective caesarean section in a large cohort of routinely handled twin pregnancies.
